description:
Click here to build your charisma with daily reps
👉 https://bit.ly/010-26-7Principles


Charisma is not something you’re born with. It’s a set of social skills you can train, rep by rep, until confidence, connection, and self-expression become second nature. In this video, Charlie shares the 7 principles that helped him build his charisma from the ground up, and how you can start doing the same.


0:00 - Intro
0:36 - Charisma is a muscle
2:44 - Charisma has 5 types
4:55 - Confidence is "I'll be okay"
6:05 - You are always broadcasting
7:43 - Trying to be liked backfires
9:22 - The leader humanizes first
10:41 - Fear is the wall
